name: Workflow Composer
description: BYO orchestrator that demonstrates the A2A v1 Agent Composition pattern. Runs realistic end-to-end care arcs by consulting TrustedRisk federation specialists (discharge, acute, evidence, population, pediatric, mental-health, pa, scribe, patient, pgx, pophealth, preadmit, quality, multimodal, coder, appeals) in sequence. The full library spans 257 care-arc templates (58 base verticals A-J, 50 macros that chain bases through ${steps.X.output.Y} references, 149 payer- and severity-parametric variants). Each workflow declares its required inputs and the per-step specialist + tool + input-mapping; the orchestrator resolves variable references and produces a complete trace per execution.

skills.name: Run a clinical workflow template
skills.description: Execute one of the 257 prebuilt care-arc templates by id (58 base + 50 macro + 149 parametric variants). Each template specifies the participating specialists and the per-step inputs.
examples: Run the chf_admission workflow for a 72y patient with SOB
Run the sepsis_workup workflow for a febrile patient with hypotension
Run the discharge_planning workflow on a CHF patient ready to go home
Run the outpatient_med_review workflow on a geriatric patient with 9 chronic medications
Run the stroke_alert workflow on a patient at 90 minutes from LKW

skills.name: List available workflow templates
skills.description: Return the marketplace-style listing of the 257 prebuilt care-arc templates with their required inputs and specialists consulted.
examples: What clinical workflows can the composer run?

extensions.description: FHIR context propagated through to the consulted specialists. The composer passes the BYO orchestrator's FHIR context unchanged on each step.

agentComposition.description: Consults the 9 TrustedRisk federation specialists in sequence per a workflow template. Each specialist receives the FHIR context unchanged and contributes a structured artefact (DecisionCard, RiskEstimate, ClinicalNoteDraft, PA*, etc.) that downstream steps can reference via ${steps.<id>.output.<field>}.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: Bearer-token authentication (RFC 6749 Sec. 4.4). Same OAuth client registry as the rest of the TrustedRisk federation.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Static API-key authentication for marketplace-mediated A2A calls.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
